what: Required checks in the arm-B corpus (tasks-sonnet5, generator claude-sonnet-5) that the reference solution fails. Arm B is published as it was run; no file was changed.
how: The reference solutions (ground_truth.solution_commands) of all 600 rounds were replayed twice with --agent expert, semantic checks graded by gemini-3.6-flash as in the arm-B evaluations. check_index: 0-based index into ground_truth.evaluation_checks of tasks/<task_id>/specs.json in tasks-sonnet5.

None of the 24 arm-B evaluation runs passes these 8 rounds. The failing check in multi_device_pairing_v03_r05 is solvable (15 of 24 runs pass it); the reference command is wrong.

impact_upper_bound_pp.note: aligned_setting_high, counting a round as passed if it failed only on listed checks. Most listed semantic checks are not unsolvable: Claude Opus 5 r01 passes 5 rounds whose reference fails.
impact_upper_bound_pp.format: [pass rate % in eval-sonnet5, upper-bound increase in points]
